body.name: learned-projection and mixed-bias gauges
body.construction: Let \(\delta_{D,n}=O_p\{B_{J_n}(e_{h,4,n}+e_{q,4,n})+e_{h,4,n}e_{q,4,n}\}\), \(b_{\rho,n}=\rho_n\|b_{J_n}\|_2/\kappa_{J_n}\), and let \(\eta_{G,n}\) and \(\eta_{c,n}\) bound the foldwise empirical Gram and score--dictionary cross-moment perturbations. The primitive mixed-bias gauge is \(L_n\min\{r_{h,n}e_{q,2,n},r_{q,n}e_{h,2,n}\}\).
